page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz and includes a 35 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 7025.92 and a Passmark CPU score of 8313.72. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1318.98 and a weak single-threaded gzip compression rate of 23.01 GB/sec. Memory subsystem performance is solid, with cached small-block read bandwidth reaching 392.36 GB/sec and uncached large-block read bandwidth at 50.58 GB/sec. Despite the redis designation, Redis SET operations performed in the bottom 25% tier at 6.81 million operations per second, and multi-core Geekbench results were also in the lower quartile.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re6p-redis.2xlarge offers a dedicated hardware profile with standard resource density, making it a stable choice for workloads requiring predictable CPU allocation without the premium of high-frequency compute nodes. Given the lack of local storage and the moderate memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, moderate database operations, static web serving, and distributed caching layers that do not demand extreme single-thread throughput.
